property_summary: For every call to forward(callee, data), c must invoke exactly the supplied callee with exactly the supplied data, so a recording callee observes the same selector and arguments that were passed; the buggy version replaces them with the empty selector, which a recording callee can detect.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call expression in forward with a call to a nonexistent selector, so the external call itself reverts and forward fails the require.
